package converted

templ navbarWithRoutes(primary templ.Component, data Navbar, summary string) {
	<div data-appkit-navbar-repair>
		@primary
		<details data-appkit-navbar-routes>
			<summary>{ summary }</summary>
			<nav aria-label={ summary }>
				<ul>
					for _, link := range data.Links {
						<li>
							<a href={ templ.SafeURL(link.URL) }
								if data.CurrentKey == link.Key {
									aria-current="page"
								}
							>{ link.Label }</a>
						</li>
					}
					if data.Notifications != nil {
						<li><a href={ templ.SafeURL(data.Notifications.URL) }>{ data.Notifications.Label }</a></li>
					}
					if data.Account != nil {
						for _, link := range data.Account.Links {
							<li><a href={ templ.SafeURL(link.URL) }>{ link.Label }</a></li>
						}
					}
				</ul>
			</nav>
		</details>
	</div>
}
